collection.description: A villager passes the huge rock they were afraid to climb as a child, and finds it is about knee high.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: When (subject) was little, there was a huge rock behind the gardens that (subject.he/she) was afraid to climb. It was enormous. A mountain. Today, passing that way for the first time in years, (subject) stops and stares at it. It's about knee high.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) steps onto the rock. It takes one step. (subject.He/She) stands on top, looking at the view, which is exactly the same as the view from the ground, only slightly higher. (subject.He/She) laughs out loud. Then (subject.he/she) sits on it for a while, feeling about six years old in the nicest possible way.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) decides the rock deserves some respect. It was a mountain once, after all. (subject.He/She) gives it a little nod and walks on. When (child), a small child, asks later whether (subject.he/she) has ever climbed the big rock behind the gardens, (subject) says, "Not yet."
